group_tail:
every standing order is an arrow on the map — click it to cancel or change it; . (Alt+. while typing) finds the next marshal with nothing to do; Ctrl-click several marshals, then a province, to march them together on one card

─────────────────────────────────────
Berthier: "Sire, the staff will read your orders as written. Should you wish the clerks to puzzle out unusual phrasings, see Settings — Smarter Parsing (optional)."

► Soult, march to Ardennes
Soult begins march to Ardennes. Route: Orleanais → Ardennes. Moves to Orleanais. "Soult, march to Ardennes." No more and no less. (1 AP — Soult executes precise orders with fewer couriers.)
   [3/4 actions remaining]


► Davout, march to Ardennes
Davout begins march to Ardennes. Route: Lorraine → Orleanais → Ardennes. Moves to Lorraine. Davout: "The roads will be scouted before each march, Sire."
   [1/4 actions remaining]

2 of 2 sent.
